mechanics.claim: The chain deals physical damage to the first enemy hit, doubled against minions.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}

mechanics.claim: If it hits a champion or large monster, a tether forms; if unbroken for 1.5s, the target takes the same damage again and is pulled.
mechanics.quote: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to the center of the area.

mechanics.claim: This ability's damage is calculated based on Aatrox's current stats at the time of the hit, not at cast.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the chain's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the chain's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
